prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose your companion"]
2: ["How to interact with your desktop pet", "Drag to move your pet around your desktop, or right-click to open controls and interaction options.", "Basic Controls Guide"]
3: ["Instant Pet Adoption", "Select from ready-to-adopt desktop pets instantly.", "Select instant pet preset"]
4: ["Signing in syncs your saved desktop pets safely to this account."]
5: ["Preparing your pet's arrival", "Generating graphics and desktop pet assets...", "Tip: If pet does not appear, check system tray icons."]
6: ["How would you like to create your pet?", "Choose between customized generation or choosing a preset companion."]
7: ["Welcome to your new desktop companion!", "Your pet is active on your screen. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to manage settings."]
8: ["Upload a clear photo of your pet", "Use well-lit photos facing forward for best generation results.", "Supports JPG & PNG. Avoid blurry or dark photos."]
9: ["Sign in to save your pet", "Log in to link your pet to your account and preserve your progress.", "Using an existing account? Your previous pets will automatically sync."]
